title: Osiris myth as preserving antediluvian knowledge via Byblos

tellings.quote: So what we have essentially here is an ark floating on the water with a body of knowledge inside of it from the anti-dolivian world.

plain: The Egyptian myth of the god Osiris, whose story carries him from Egypt to Byblos on the Phoenician coast, is read as a coded memory of "an ark floating on the water" holding a body of knowledge from the world before the great Flood. A guest named Tim Alberino offers this as his own reading of the myth on the show, without naming a source. If he is right, the old story would be preserving a memory of a lost civilization and how its knowledge survived.
